If POC shows stable latency and favorable cost curves, plan to shift to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost. Primary goals: improve ranking quality (NDCG), keep p95 latency <120ms, control per-query costs at scale, and meet SOC2/audit requirements.
